knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Rinse sampling collects residue from large or inaccessible areas. Testing only the water purity does not show residue.
Without the area, residue per unit cannot be calculated, so the result is meaningless.
Residue is not uniform, so a swab can miss the maximum. A low result from one spot does not prove the whole surface is clean.

practicalCriteria: Learner plans a sample set for a named item, including method, location, area or volume and reason (pass: all four recorded for each sample).
Learner completes a sample log for a practice swab, including the area swabbed (pass: area and location present).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A solvent would be applied without its SDS or ventilation.
A sample is unlabelled or its location cannot be confirmed.
A sample is taken from a potent or toxic material without the site's controls.
